Thank you @Meriwest for answering my dream!! 🏡Cong [image: Thank you @Meriwest for answering my dream!! 🏡Congrats to Meriwest Credit Union on launching its new HomeFast ADU Loan, an innovative financing solution designed to help homeowners build Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs)! ADUs are an important part of addressing California’s housing shortage. They create more affordable housing opportunities, provide space for aging parents or adult children, generate potential rental income, and help families build generational wealth. I applaud Meriwest Credit Union for supporting creative financing solutions that can help more Californians turn their backyards into opportunities! Meriwest’s program, introduced in 2025, offers loans starting at $25,000, with a 25-year fixed term and interest-only payments during the first 12 months, subject to approval. Learn more: https://www.meriwest.com/loans/homefast-adu-loan #MeriwestCreditUnion #HomeFast #ADU #AffordableHousing #HousingSolutions #CaliforniaDream #Homeownership #MultigenerationalLiving #CaliforniaHousing]

🏭 Made in California! Built for the Future! 🇺🇸 Yes [image: 🏭 Made in California! Built for the Future! 🇺🇸 Yesterday, my California State Treasurer’s Office hosted our 2nd Annual California Creates: Golden State Manufacturing Forum at Aggie Square in Sacramento! California is home to more than 45,000 manufacturing businesses, supporting 1.24 million jobs and generating $382 BILLION in annual economic output! We brought together manufacturers, innovators, policymakers, and financial experts to discuss access to capital, cutting red tape, workforce development, AI, biotechnology, and growing California’s creative economy. I especially enjoyed our fireside chat highlighting women shaping the future of manufacturing! Our goal: Help businesses start, grow, innovate, and create more good-paying jobs right here in California! Let’s keep making things in California! 💪 #MadeInCalifornia #CaliforniaCreates #Manufacturing #Innovation #SmallBusiness #EconomicDevelopment #GoodJobs #WomenInManufacturing #California @caltreasurer @camanufacturers @khaimmorton @rachell_reinwald @sarecycling @sacstate]
